outcome.name: decision
outcome.sentence: The model gave this case a 59.5% chance of decline. That is at or above the 50% threshold, so the outcome is decline.
outcome.label: decline

explanation.method_sentence: Shapley values: each input's fair share of the difference between this case and the average case.
explanation.reproducible_sentence: The method was exact: every combination of inputs was evaluated, so the same model version and reference data give the same numbers every time.

reference.sentence: The starting point is 49.0%: the model's average chance of decline across 64 rows drawn from the model's reference data.

explanation.summary: Together the inputs raise the chance of decline by 10.4 percentage points, from the starting point of 49.0% to this case's 59.5%.

counterfactual.note: This is a property of the model, not advice: the change found may be unrealistic, and the inputs held fixed are a choice.
counterfactual.sentence: Changing bureau credit score from 681 to 850 would move the chance of decline from 59.5% to 8.3%, which makes the outcome approve. Held fixed in the search: applicant age.

reasons.notice: Draft reasons, drawn from the model's explanation with wording your organization approved. They cover the model's part of the decision only. Whether they meet a notice requirement is for counsel.

limits.title: It describes the model, not the world.
limits.text: It shows how the model reached its output. On its own it does not show that the decision was fair, lawful or correct.

limits.title: It is not causation.
limits.text: It shows how the model's output responds to its inputs, not that changing an input in the real world would change the real outcome.

limits.title: It is not a fairness test.
limits.text: A protected characteristic can influence decisions through other inputs that correlate with it, without appearing in the list.

limits.title: It does not check the data.
limits.text: If an input is wrong, the explanation faithfully explains the wrong input.

limits.title: It does not see your policy.
limits.text: Rules applied outside the model, such as cut-offs, overlays and manual decisions, are not part of the explanation.

notice: This record states what Kaimei stored and computed. It can support a compliance process; it does not make a decision, a notice or a filing compliant, and it is not legal advice.

fingerprint.covers: The decision id, the model and its version, the logged input, output and time, and the explanation's method, options and numbers.
